description: This Java source file defines the CollectionConverters class and nested classes, providing various converters for collection types such as arrays, lists, maps, and sets, including conversion to and from strings.

classes.name: CollectionConverters
classes.description: Main class providing collection conversion utilities and nested converter classes.

classes.name: ArrayCreator
classes.description: Creates converters for array to list conversions.

classes.name: ArrayClassToList
classes.description: Converts arrays of a specific class to lists.

classes.name: MapToList
classes.description: Wraps a Map into a List containing that Map.

classes.name: MapToSet
classes.description: Wraps a Map into a Set containing that Map.

classes.name: StringToList
classes.description: Converts String to List of Strings, with special handling for bracketed lists.

classes.name: StringToMap
classes.description: Converts String to Map<String, String> with parsing logic.

classes.name: StringToSet
classes.description: Converts String to Set of Strings, with special handling for bracketed sets.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads contained converters for collection types.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates a converter for array to list if source is array and target is List.

methods.name: canConvert
methods.description: Checks if conversion between source and target classes is possible.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs the conversion logic for each specific converter.
